fill_index_hint.title: How to read fill index
fill_index_hint.xx: XX = percentage completeness of the volume (ratio of preserved issues to expected issues).
fill_index_hint.yyy: YYY = a three-digit code describing preserved-issue characteristics; evaluated only for issues that are actually present in the volume.
fill_index_hint.position_1: Position 1: occurrence of missing pages within issues (page completeness).
fill_index_hint.position_2: Position 2: general physical or structural damage (e.g., degradation, unreadable binding).
fill_index_hint.position_3: Position 3: other, usually less significant attributes (e.g., wrong pagination, date, numbering, binding, censorship interventions).
fill_index_hint.example: Example 88–732: about 88% of expected issues are preserved; in present issues about 30% of pages are missing and the rest is quite damaged.
fill_index_hint.color_scale: Dot color follows index scale: ≤ 50,000 dark red, midpoint orange, 100,000 bright green.
